claim_detail.motion_result: no motion plan found for the final descent to inverted_u_yellow_placement after repeated attempts (including solve_ik_first, which timed out)

arguments.notes: Between completing place_approach_inverted_u_yellow and attempting the final descent, u_brown, u_orange and line_green -- all previously verified within tolerance -- were found displaced far beyond their disturbance tolerances; u_orange in particular is now off the fixture entirely. The registry's acm_allowed_object_pairs (needed for planning tractability around intended contacts) covers every pair including inverted_u_yellow against the three seated parts, so MoveIt's planner did not flag contact between the held part/arm and those seated parts as a collision while transporting and staging inverted_u_yellow in this tightly packed region -- but the task's own working notes are explicit that this ACM setting carries no permission for that contact to actually happen, and the invariant against disturbing seated parts was violated here even though no planner error was raised. The final descent itself also then failed to find a motion plan (and solve_ik_first timed out), consistent with the fixture-area geometry no longer being clear. I retreated the arm (lift + safe pose) and am holding the run rather than attempting further motion in this contaminated region.
